  372: 
  373: ### What the framework has not proven
  374: - That the Jensen modulus s has a preferred value (modulus stabilization).
  375: - That the framework makes a single quantitative prediction that can be tested against
  376:   experiment (gauge coupling ratios require s_0, which requires stabilization).
  377: - That the non-perturbative physics exists to fill the gap left by the closed 1-loop CW.
  378: 
  379: ### The analogy I keep returning to
  380: In 1905, I derived the kinematics of special relativity from two principles. The dynamics
  381: (how forces work in relativistic mechanics) took 10 more years and required a completely
  382: new mathematical framework (Riemannian geometry). The kinematics were correct the entire
  383: time.

   11: ### 1.1 The Constant-Ratio Trap as a Structural Theorem
   12:

   14: 
   15: From my perspective as a mass quantization analyst, this is the most important finding of the entire session. The fiber dimension ratio determines the asymptotic F/B balance:
   16: 
   17: - Bosonic fiber: 1 (scalar) + 8 (vector) + 35 (TT at tau=0) = 44
   18: - Fermionic fiber: 16 (Dirac spinor)
   19: - Asymptotic ratio: 16/44 = 0.364 --> after spectral weighting, converges to ~0.55
   20:

  154: Every entry in this table traces directly to a KK paper in the reference corpus. The perturbative toolkit of KK theory -- Einstein equations, heat kernel, Lichnerowicz operator, gauge thresholds -- has been systematically applied and exhausted.
  155: 
  156: ### 4.2 What Survives is What Kerner and Witten Could Not Compute
  157: 
  158: The surviving routes -- BCS condensate, Freund-Rubin double-well, topological transitions -- are precisely the non-perturbative phenomena that the classical KK literature identified but could not compute:
  159: 
  160: - **Kerner (Paper 06)** derived the Yang-Mills equations from the bundle curvature but could not analyze the quantum vacuum (no effective action technology in 1968).
  161: - **Witten (Paper 09)** identified the chirality obstruction but could not resolve it (no NCG spectral triple technology in 1981).
  162: - **Freund-Rubin (Paper 10)** showed flux can drive compactification but could not compute the one-loop corrections to the flux potential.
  163: - **Duff-Nilsson-Pope (Paper 11)** analyzed squashed S^7 stability at the classical level but deferred quantum corrections.
  164: 
  165: The phonon-exflation framework has now closed the perturbative chapter that these authors opened. What remains is the chapter they could not write: the non-perturbative quantum dynamics of the internal geometry.
